title: Economic World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.32663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can artificial intelligence reproduce the economic dynamics that emerge as households, firms and governments interact and adapt through markets and institutions? To answer this question, we define an economic world model (EWM) as an agent's internal representation of how an economic system works, enabling counterfactual simulation and decision-making under resource constraints. We then propose a general framework for studying EWMs that links three tasks: simulating agent behaviour, learning economic transitions and systematically evaluating the dynamics. As an initial implementation, we learn household policies from microeconomic data and calibrate a structural economic transition model using macroeconomic data, linking individual decisions to aggregate dynamics. Our micro-to-macro evaluation framework compares simulated individual actions and group distributions with observed microdata and assesses macroeconomic dynamics through forecas

translated_abstract: 人工智能能否复现家庭、企业和政府通过市场与制度相互作用及适应所产生的经济动态？为了回答这个问题，我们将经济世界模型（EWM）定义为智能体对经济系统运行方式的内部表征，使其能够在资源约束下进行反事实模拟和决策。随后，我们提出了一个研究经济世界模型的通用框架，该框架连接了三项任务：模拟智能体行为、学习经济转移规律以及系统性地评估动态。作为初步实现，我们从微观经济数据中学习家庭策略，并利用宏观经济数据校准结构性经济转移模型，从而将个体决策与总体动态联系起来。我们的微观到宏观评估框架将模拟的个体行为和群体分布与观测到的微观数据进行比较，并通过预测来评估宏观经济动态。
tldr: 本文提出经济世界模型（EWM）的概念及通用研究框架，通过从微观经济数据学习家庭策略并结合宏观数据校准结构性经济转移模型，实现了个体决策与总体经济动态相连接的微观到宏观模拟与评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of an Economic World Model (EWM) and a general framework that learns household policies from microdata and calibrates structural economic transition models with macrodata, linking individual decisions to aggregate economic dynamics through a micro-to-macro evaluation.
